title: Run control command v1

run_id.description: Optional current-run precondition, checked under the run lock before every control mutation; mismatch returns 409.

epoch.description: Optional current-epoch precondition, checked under the run lock before every control mutation; mismatch returns 409.

speed.description: For speed actions only, supported standalone values are 1, 5, 20, 60.

time_zone.description: Supported IANA timezone name, validated by each backend.

description: Action is in the URL. Reset requires current confirm_run_id; scenario may change only on reset; connected reset/speed are forbidden; finalization requires SQL and native completion barriers. Business close must be later than open within one local day. These state/cross-field conditions are enforced by each backend.
